notice: Sample item rulebook. Every position below is illustrative and must be checked against the unit's scales, the DFPDS schedules and formation orders before use.

items.name: Office furniture
items.authorised: Against the office furniture scale for the appointment and room
items.sourceText: Locally procurable within scales; often listed on GeM
items.head: Furniture (sample head)
cautions: Check GeM first; most office furniture is listed there.

items.name: Sofas and lounge furniture
items.authorised: Only where the furniture scale for that room or appointment provides it; not usually scaled for troops' lines
items.sourceText: Locally procurable where scaled; often listed on GeM
items.head: Furniture (sample head)
cautions: Sofas for an officers' or JCOs' mess, a club or a unit institute are usually bought from that fund, not from public money.

items.name: Barrack and accommodation furniture
items.authorised: Against the accommodation scale for the barrack or quarters
items.sourceText: Locally procurable within scales; some items come through the station's furniture pool
items.head: Furniture (sample head)
cautions: Check with the station whether the furniture pool can issue it before buying.

items.name: Curtains, carpets and furnishings
items.authorised: Against accommodation scales; blankets and bedding for troops are usually scaled issues
items.sourceText: Locally procurable within scales
items.head: Furniture (sample head)
cautions: Furnishings for a mess or institute are usually bought from that fund.

items.name: Air conditioners, coolers, fans and heaters
items.authorised: Air conditioners only where the appointment or equipment room is authorised; fans and heaters against accommodation scales
items.sourceText: Locally procurable within scales; installation may need the engineer services
items.head: Electrical appliances (sample head)
cautions: Fixed installations (split ACs, geysers) may be engineer services work, not a store purchase.

items.name: Refrigerators, TVs and household appliances
items.authorised: Only where a scale provides it, such as a TV for a recreation room
items.sourceText: Locally procurable where scaled; usually listed on GeM
items.head: Electrical appliances (sample head)
cautions: Appliances for a mess, club or unit institute are usually bought from that fund.

items.name: Water purifiers and water coolers
items.sourceText: Locally procurable within scales
items.head: Amenities (sample head)

items.name: Solar lights, generators and inverters
items.sourceText: May be locally procurable; engineer stores may hold them
items.head: Engineer stores (sample head)
cautions: Check with engineer channels before buying; fixed wiring is engineer services work.

items.name: Kitchen and cookhouse equipment
items.authorised: Cookhouse equipment against the cookhouse scale
items.sourceText: Locally procurable within scales; often listed on GeM
items.head: Cookhouse equipment (sample head)
items.schedule: Cookhouse and kitchen stores (sample schedule item)
cautions: Crockery and kitchen items for an officers' or JCOs' mess are usually bought from mess funds.

items.name: Rations and fresh supplies
items.sourceText: Centrally supplied; not a unit purchase
items.head: Not a unit head
cautions: Raise requirements through the supply chain, not by local purchase.

items.name: Computers, printers and IT peripherals
items.sourceText: Locally procurable with IT security conditions
items.head: IT hardware (sample head)
cautions: IT security instructions may restrict makes, models and where devices can connect.
Check GeM first.

items.name: Software and online subscriptions
items.sourceText: Restricted; needs IT security approval
items.head: IT services (sample head)
cautions: Cloud services, online accounts and internet connections usually need explicit security clearance.

items.name: Office stationery and printer consumables
items.sourceText: Locally procurable; usually listed on GeM
items.head: Office contingencies (sample head)
items.schedule: Stationery and office contingencies (sample schedule item)
cautions: Check GeM first; most stationery is listed there.

items.name: Printing, signboards and banners
items.authorised: Covered by office contingencies where the need is official
items.sourceText: Locally procurable
items.head: Office contingencies (sample head)

items.name: Training aids
items.authorised: Usually within training scales; check the unit's scale
items.sourceText: Locally procurable
items.head: Training (sample head)
items.schedule: Training aids and equipment (sample schedule item)
cautions: Simulators that connect to weapons or networks may need separate technical approval.

items.name: Books, journals and library
items.sourceText: Locally procurable
items.head: Training (sample head)
cautions: Newspapers for a mess or institute reading room are usually paid from that fund.

items.name: 3D printer for the workshop
items.sourceText: Needs special sanction as a non-scaled item
items.head: Workshop or innovation (sample head)
cautions: Write the case around what it will produce and save.

items.name: Sports and gym equipment
items.authorised: Within physical training scales; extra items may fall under welfare
items.sourceText: Locally procurable
items.head: Physical training and welfare (sample head)
items.schedule: Sports and PT stores (sample schedule item)
cautions: If bought from a regimental or welfare fund it is outside this tool's scope.

items.name: Vehicle spares
items.sourceText: Centrally provisioned; raise a demand. Local purchase only when the depot cannot supply and the need is urgent
items.head: Vehicle maintenance (sample head)
items.schedule: Local purchase of spares (sample schedule item)
cautions: Keep the non-availability certificate from the depot on file.

items.name: Vehicles
items.sourceText: Not a unit purchase; vehicles are provisioned centrally or by capital acquisition
items.head: Not a unit head
cautions: To hire a vehicle for a task, ask about hiring of civil transport instead.

items.name: Fuel and lubricants
items.sourceText: Centrally supplied; local purchase only in narrow emergencies
items.head: Not a unit head

items.name: Medical stores
items.sourceText: Through medical channels; local purchase only in an emergency
items.head: Medical (sample head)
items.schedule: Emergency local purchase of medical stores (sample schedule item)
cautions: Route through the unit's medical officer.

items.name: Uniforms and clothing
items.sourceText: Centrally provisioned through ordnance channels; not a unit purchase
items.head: Not a unit head
cautions: Team kit bought from a regimental fund is outside this tool.

items.name: Tents and camp stores
items.authorised: By equipment table and camp stores scale
items.sourceText: Centrally provisioned; hire locally only for events where allowed
items.head: Not a unit head
cautions: For a one-off event, hiring a shamiana may be possible under hiring powers.

items.name: Tools and workshop equipment
items.sourceText: Locally procurable within scales
items.head: Workshop stores (sample head)

items.name: Cleaning and conservancy supplies
items.authorised: Covered by conservancy and contingency scales
items.sourceText: Locally procurable; usually listed on GeM
items.head: Conservancy (sample head)

items.name: CCTV and security systems
items.sourceText: Restricted; needs security approval
items.head: Security (sample head)
cautions: Recorded footage and network connection need approval.

items.name: Arms, ammunition and controlled stores
items.sourceText: Centrally provisioned only; never bought locally
items.head: Not a unit head
cautions: Not locally procurable under any circumstances in this tool.

items.name: Drones and unmanned aerial systems
items.sourceText: Needs special authorisation; may be capital or emergency procurement
items.head: Not a routine unit head
cautions: Security and airspace approvals apply.
Do not plan a local purchase without formation guidance.

items.name: Buildings, repairs and construction
items.sourceText: Works done through the engineer services; outside this tool
items.head: Works (outside scope)
cautions: Raise a works requirement through the station and engineer channels.

items.name: Mementos, gifts and decorations
items.sourceText: Usually from regimental funds, or under hospitality powers for official functions
items.head: Hospitality or non-public (sample)
cautions: Check which fund pays before using public money; gifts are tightly limited.

items.name: Band and musical instruments
items.authorised: Band instruments by band scale; others not scaled
items.sourceText: Band instruments through band channels; recreational instruments usually from regimental funds
items.head: Welfare or non-public (sample)

items.name: Events and functions
items.authorised: Only for official functions within hospitality powers
items.sourceText: Official functions under hospitality powers; unit celebrations usually from regimental funds
items.head: Hospitality or non-public (sample)

items.name: Hiring of civil transport
items.authorised: When service transport is not available
items.sourceText: Hired locally
items.head: Transport (sample head)
items.schedule: Hiring of civil transport (sample schedule item)
cautions: Record why service transport could not be used.

items.name: Repairs and maintenance contracts (AMC)
items.sourceText: Contracted locally; often available on GeM as a service
items.head: Maintenance services (sample head)
cautions: Services follow the same value bands as goods; check GeM services first.
